purpose: Upstream replay of shopify-admin-2025-01-removal: each app at the commit before its maintainers moved off Admin API 2025-01 by hand (docs/benchmarks/2026-10-22-upstream-replay-cases.json), for npm run benchmark:shopify -- --list.

schemas.source: https://shopify.dev/admin-graphql-direct-proxy/<version> (public documentation proxy; introspection with descriptions and deprecated input values, no store or credentials)
schemas.note: The schemas available to this replay are 2026-01 to 2026-10, the same pinned introspection as the fresh Shopify set. 2025-01 and 2025-07 schemas were not available, so the before contract is 2026-01, the oldest pinned version, which is what Shopify serves a 2025-01 pin today.
